_meta.title: Underkeep research tree and asset plan

units.gold: whole gold coins; runtime stores hundredths

planningAssumptions: This is a complete proposed tree for the stated scope, not a claim that every node exists in the demo.
Keep every archived research ID; expand repeatable depth purchases into explicit milestones with legacy mapping.
Tier I and II character baselines retain 10 and 20. Later character tiers rise linearly to 50, avoiding repeated doubling.
Five equipment tiers each cover roughly ten floors; every five-floor group has its own editable policy.
Research grants permission; it does not replace installed fixtures, upgrade spawners or refill resources for free.
All durations and added prices are tuning candidates, not balance-tested outcomes.
No actual game mode switch or runtime edits are required to review this planning document.
formatNotes: Each research branch is a top-level object. Entity families contain level_1, level_2 and subsequent levels.
Entity stats are directly on each level. Mob spawners are nested inside the corresponding mob level.
Research is keyed by stable research ID inside each branch; cross-branch prerequisites retain those IDs.
Existing fixed health and defense values are expressed as equal minimum and maximum values. No new random stat ranges are introduced.
Example numbers from the formatting request were not treated as balance changes.
spawnRate is the number of mobs per successful spawn event; spawnPeriodInGameHours is the interval. The spelling of Period is intentional.
Unknown initial per-spawner costs are null, not zero. Existing tier-upgrade prices are recorded separately as upgradeCost.
Character maxHealth and maxDefense remain resource caps; these are not random spawn ranges.
Asset definitions and general rules remain in _shared to avoid duplication.

researchRules.cancel: no refund after start; confirmation required
researchRules.prerequisites: allOf must be complete; repeated IDs mean at least rank 1
researchRules.queue: one active node; unavailable buttons explain prerequisite or insufficient gold
researchRules.sharedNode: Better building belongs to Dungeon depths; Staff investment links to the same ID
researchRules.effectComposition: set replaces previous research value; add accumulates per rank; compute from immutable baseline plus completed research, never mutate accumulated derived values repeatedly
researchRules.migration: existing completed IDs remain completed; existing depth rank maps to first N depth milestones; no retroactive charges

defaultInstallationPurchase.note: Per-fixture or per-spawner tier-upgrade price overrides this default for upgrades; gold stocked in chests is charged separately.

researchRules.existingSaveApplication: This file is a plan only. A future migration must preview changed defaults, preserve earned stat deltas and task work fractions, and avoid silently altering the archived demo.

statSemantics.defense: depleting shield pool, blue above red health
statSemantics.primary: strength, mana or divinity; consumable current resource separate from permanent maximum
statSemantics.xpPerStatPoint: higher means slower learning; not a beneficial learning-rate multiplier
statSemantics.researchTier: content tier, distinct from skill-point gains
statSemantics.resourceRecovery: quiet outside rooms: 0.5 points/game hour to health, defense, stamina and primary; baseline rooms: 2; room tiers: 3 and 4
statSemantics.xp: one XP per qualifying skill use; spend stamina awards one stamina XP event, not one per point; defense XP on absorbed damage; checkpoint commits adventurer XP, office rest commits staff XP

formulas.attack: damage + currentPrimary; consume 1 primary if available
formulas.resetTiming: capture effective rate at task start; on explicit configuration changes preserve fractional work and recompute remaining duration
formulas.treasureLock: intelligence >= lockIntelligence; no hidden success roll in this proposal
formulas.mobSpawn: interval from entity; stagger phases evenly; at cap hold one ready mob only
formulas.arrival: base 1 game hour * guild multiplier / active multiplier, per point; stagger phases; class ratios 3:2:1 without guild; guild fills missing 2 fighter:1 wizard:1 healer roles
formulas.partyFormation: base 480 game seconds (20 real seconds); guild II 360; guild III 240; population caps never prevent backlog formation
formulas.capacity: 60 + 10 per purchased extra arrival point + guild capacity bonus
formulas.diggingProposed: baseRealMinutes=10*1.15^(floorNumber-1); elapsed work scales by 3/activeDiggers/excavationThroughputMultiplier; add rest and queue dependencies

assetDirection.style: 2D pixel art; nearest-neighbor scaling; common feet anchor
assetDirection.characters: 3 authored variants per adventurer class/tier and zombie tier, 1 per staff job/tier and slime tier; use saved deterministic 0.8–1.2 saturation multiplier
assetDirection.portraits: derive from the same authored variant and palette, not separately painted conflicting icons
assetDirection.facing: author one canonical direction; mirror for travel, with separate unmirrored labels
assetDirection.floorLayout: 15 columns: exit, 12 fixtures, rest, entry. Top to bottom: header, fixture information, resource bars, scene.
assetDirection.runtimeLabels: text, gold counts, progress rings and bars are UI, not baked into sprites
assetDirection.reuse: reuse animation rigs, collision footprints, VFX and shared materials; tier must still be recognizable without color
assetDirection.sourceSelection: keep frozen demo selections for base variants; new tiers require review
assetDirection.stateNotes: destroyed_outline is a shared red-outline shader; construction reveals are reusable masks; listed states need not each require a fully separate sheet
assetDirection.inventoryCounting: An asset family is a character/tier, fixture/tier, room/tier, environment tier or building. AuthoredVariantSets sums variants, not frames or exported files. Portraits derive from sheets; UI text and shader states do not add painted frame counts.

animationFrameBudgetProposal.note: Budgets for art estimation only; finalize after animation readability review.

sharedAssets.deliverables: one branch icon per branch and a unique research icon where silhouette differs; otherwise tier numeral overlay
red health, blue defense, green stamina, class primary and gold XP bars; purple research progress; complete circular countdown; capped yellow pulse
lock unlock, work, queue check, healing, block, level-up, complaint, gold transfer

designDecisionsToReview.proposal: Use explicit minimum and maximum admission tiers per group. Reject unaffordable or out-of-range visitors immediately unless they opt into available training before admission.
designDecisionsToReview.reason: Archived maximum-tier predicate conflicts with earlier minimum-tier expectations and immediate departure conflicts with training.

designDecisionsToReview.proposal: Reduce per-floor growth from 1.5 to 1.15 before 50-floor production balance.
designDecisionsToReview.reason: 1.5^49 makes late floors impractical. New curve still needs staffing/rest simulations.

designDecisionsToReview.proposal: Normalize trapdoor I perception from archived 12 to 10; stealth ranks improve arrow walls from 5 to 10.
designDecisionsToReview.reason: Existing cap of 10 conflicts with trapdoor baseline 12.

designDecisionsToReview.proposal: Keep 80-intelligence royal locks as a stretch goal reached by checkpoint progression from tier V intelligence 50.
designDecisionsToReview.reason: Validate realistic XP income; reduce threshold if most parties cannot reach it.

designDecisionsToReview.proposal: Retain damage=max(0,attack-floorDefense), with maintenance repairs; decide collapse rules separately.
designDecisionsToReview.reason: Strong adventurers can damage even matching-tier floors; requires economy/load testing.

designDecisionsToReview.proposal: No passive gold multiplier research; upgrades increase throughput, costs and danger together.
designDecisionsToReview.reason: Test wages, checkpoint fees and funded treasure for sustainable margins.

designDecisionsToReview.proposal: Keep the one-minute minimum reset duration, then test whether tier V staff trivialize all reset work; optionally shift later staff gains toward stamina instead of speed.
designDecisionsToReview.reason: Tier V speed/intelligence plus tools exceeds tier V reset difficulty by 100 points.

admission.validation: minimumTier <= maximumTier; max selectable content tier must be unlocked

staff.note: Emergency reset preempts installation when stamina can pay its cost; never interrupt an already-paid action by charging twice.

floor.validation: sum of fixtures <= 12; active mob occupancy can exceed a lowered cap but new spawning pauses; structural stats read-only outside developer configuration

configurationControls.population: Caps affect new arrivals only, never legal party formation from the backlog.
